title: Mission Planning & Simulation Implementation Blueprint
author: Antigravity (Advanced Agentic Coding)

overview.goal: Implement an end-to-end, web-native Mission Planning and Mission Simulation layer for Project ANUMAAN, seamlessly integrating with the existing 5-engine physical runtime, FlyHash novelty gate, Bayesian diagnostic network, 3D WebGL twin, and sortie replay engine.
overview.execution_target: Entirely inside the Web Application (React + Three.js + FastAPI)

api_endpoints.description: List standard mission templates (Ladakh, Thar, Maritime, Canyon Dash)
Validate mission route and compute preflight analytic reliability
api_endpoints.response_schema: { valid: boolean, errors: string[], preflight_reliability: number, limiting_component: string }

api_endpoints.description: Instantiate and run the time-stepped mission executive
api_endpoints.response_schema: { session_id: string, status: string, start_time: number }

api_endpoints.description: Resume active mission simulation with optional time-scale update
Abort mission simulation and command immediate RTB vector
Apply prescriptive power derate to active mission profile
api_endpoints.response_schema: { applied_power_scale: number, updated_reliability: number, endurance_penalty_min: number }

api_endpoints.description: Fetch instantaneous snapshot of the active mission state
Finalize completed/aborted mission and write replayable sortie files
api_endpoints.response_schema: { sortie_id: string, csv_path: string, manifest_path: string, debrief_path: string }

phases.title: Mission Core Models & Simulation Executive
phases.description: Build the canonical data models, waypoint interpolator, atmospheric ISA engine, and time-stepped simulation runner.

tasks.name: Implement Canonical Mission Models
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dataclasses for Waypoint, ScheduledEvent, EnvironmentalConditions, MissionDefinition, and MissionState with Pydantic serialization.

tasks.name: Implement Atmospheric & Kinematics Engine
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Calculates standard atmospheric temperature, pressure, density altitude, coordinated turn bank angle, and waypoint progress at 20 Hz.

tasks.name: Implement Mission Executive Runner
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Supports START, PAUSE, RESUME, ABORT, variable time compression (1x, 2x, 5x, 10x), and enforces all flight phases.

phases.title: EngineRuntime Levers & Fault Dispatch Integration
phases.description: Connect the time-stepped MissionExecutive to the authoritative concurrent RuntimeHub for all 5 engines.

tasks.name: Wire Mission Executive to EngineRuntime Levers
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Executive pushes instantaneous (throttle_pct, altitude_ft, oat_c) into EngineRuntime.set_levers() at 20 Hz for whichever engine is active.

tasks.name: Dual-Mode Fault Dispatch Engine
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Executes scheduled events at mission elapsed time T and accepts operator live injection through the same canonical Runtime.inject_fault() pipeline.

tasks.name: Multi-Engine Validation Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pytest verifies all 5 engine configurations run through a climb-cruise-descent profile with unique physical responses.

phases.title: FlyHash Novelty & Dynamic Reliability Integration
phases.description: Wire the FlyHash sparse random projection gate and dynamic Weibull survival updating into the active simulation loop.

tasks.name: Wire FlyHash Novelty Gate into EngineRuntime Ingest
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ResidualVector and order features are encoded by FlyNoveltyDetector; tick payload carries novelty_score and is_novel flag.

tasks.name: Dynamic In-Flight Mission Reliability Updates
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Recalculates R(remaining_sortie) and PrescriptiveAdvisor derate schedules whenever damage accumulates or anomaly is confirmed.

phases.title: Web 3D Canyon Flight Twin (Three.js WebGL)
phases.description: Port the desktop Blender canyon flight simulator into a high-performance web-native Three.js component.

tasks.name: Migrate 3D Assets to Public Directory
tasks.acceptance_criteria: delta-pbr.glb and terrain.glb are accessible via frontend Vite dev server and build bundle.

tasks.name: Build WebGL Canyon Flight Scene
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Renders terrain mesh, atmospheric fog, tactical lighting, and delta airframe at >= 60 FPS.

tasks.name: Implement Flight Kinematics & Waypoint Visualizer
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interpolates aircraft position along 3D waypoints, animates propeller, renders active flight corridor, and provides Auto-GCAS warning cone.

phases.title: Mission Planning & Simulation Web Interface
phases.description: Build the user-facing GCS Mission Operations interface in React with clean engineering aesthetics.

tasks.name: Build Mission Planner Form & Route Builder
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Allows operator to select theater presets, customize waypoints, schedule faults, select engine, and review pre-flight reliability.

tasks.name: Build Mission Execution Cockpit
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Displays WebGL 3D flight canvas, virtual gauges, mission timeline scrubber, and active phase indicators.

tasks.name: Build Prescriptive Decision & Operator Response Panel
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Provides one-click execution of recommended power derating, divert vectors, or emergency RTB with updated ETA.

tasks.name: Integrate Mission Operations into App Navigation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Wires the full mission suite into the unified GCS navigation shell under 'Mission / Operations'.

phases.title: Autonomous Sortie Packaging & Seamless Replay Bridge
phases.description: Automatically package completed or aborted simulation runs into standard replayable sorties without fabricated data.

tasks.name: Implement Sortie Archive Generator
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Writes actual 20 Hz simulation ticks to data/telemetry/{id}.csv, generates {id}_manifest.json, and produces debrief markdown.

tasks.name: Bridge Simulation Completion to Replay Scrubber
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Presents sortie debrief summary with a direct 'Open in Historical Replay' action that immediately switches to the Replay tab.

phases.title: Comprehensive Regression Testing & Visual QA
phases.description: Ensure zero regressions across existing tests, 100% build health, and verify multi-engine mission simulation end-to-end.

tasks.name: Backend Mission Simulation Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pytest suite tests preflight validation, 10x accelerated simulation, fault injection, and sortie export across all 5 engines.

tasks.name: Playwright Browser Verification Script
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Automated headless browser script creates a mission, simulates flight, verifies WebGL 3D canyon, injects a fault, applies derate, and verifies replay.

acceptance_checklist: Mission Planning is 100% web-native with zero dependency on desktop Blender.
All 5 engines (Rotax 912/914/915, Austro AE300, VRDE Jayem) run through realistic mission flight profiles.
Flight profile dynamically sets altitude, OAT, ambient pressure, and throttle into EngineRuntime.
Ladakh High-Altitude Cold vs. Thar Hot-and-High presets produce distinct, physics-backed thermal behavior.
Scheduled and Live fault injections follow the identical plant-to-PHM pipeline.
FlyHash novelty detector is active in the live tick loop as an unsupervised novelty gate.
Prescriptive derate recommendations allow operator in-flight response to preserve the airframe.
Completed simulations automatically export authentic CSV sorties directly readable by Mission Replay.
The 3D WebGL canyon twin renders authentic Blender-derived delta airframe and Ladakh terrain meshes.
No AI slop, fake HUDs, glowing decorative cards, or fabricated telemetry numbers.
